plain: A separate component that turns the situation and its norms into a checkable policy and then allows or blocks each action an AI agent proposes.
eli5: A hall monitor who writes the rules for this room and then checks every move the robot makes.
technical: A design pattern named by the agentic-privacy report (Bagdasarian, Tsai et al. 2026) after seeing it in several systems: a component, separate from the planning model, that generates a formal machine-checkable policy from context and norms and enforces it at runtime by allowing, denying, modifying or escalating each action; feeding policy generation only trusted inputs, as Conseca does, is one design choice within it.
